propositions: One environment variable (REBAR_LLM_MODEL) cannot express the required per-pass model configuration: Pass-1 on frontier (opus) and Pass-2/Pass-4 on standard (sonnet).
Code-review gate steps base, round_a, round_b, and coach implicitly inherit cfg.model instead of declaring per-step classes, blocking per-provider resolution.
Step-level model declarations are silently ignored by the batch runner path (interpreter.py:384-395 reads only batch sub-dict), making model_ladder the sole mechanism for batch step configuration.
Verifier downgrade logic in review_kernel/verify.py:269 and completion.py:332 inverts on non-default providers, causing Pass-2/Pass-4 to follow Pass-1 model instead of downgrading to sonnet.
The model_ladder for code-review batch steps must use a single rung (frontier/standard) not multiple rungs, to preserve deterministic per-pass model binding.
